title: Outdoor temperature sensor fault
fullDescription: Maytag HVAC condensers (made by Nordyne) display E1 when the outdoor ambient thermistor is open, shorted, or out of range. Variable-capacity logic falls back to default values, reducing efficiency.
safetyWarning: 240 VAC at contactor - lock out disconnect before service.
whenToCallPro: If new sensor still produces E1.

faq.a: Yes, on default backup logic with reduced efficiency.

title: Coil sensor fault
shortDescription: Outdoor coil thermistor open or out of range.
fullDescription: E2 reports outdoor coil sensor open or shorted. Affects defrost timing on heat pumps and superheat on variable-capacity units.
whenToCallPro: If sensor good and code persists.

faq.a: Clipped to a return-bend on the lower outdoor coil.

title: High pressure trip
fullDescription: E3 means the high-pressure switch opened (~600 psi R-410A). Compressor stops to prevent damage.

fixSteps.title: Wash coil
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; rinse from inside out.

fixSteps.title: Verify fan operation
fixSteps.instruction: Fan must run any time compressor runs.

title: Low pressure
shortDescription: Suction pressure below cutout - low charge or restriction.
fullDescription: E4 indicates low-side pressure dropped below the safety cutout. Most often a refrigerant leak.

faq.a: EPA forbids it without leak repair.

title: Compressor over-current
fullDescription: E5 means current draw above threshold. Common: failed run capacitor, stiff compressor, low voltage.
safetyWarning: Capacitors hold lethal charge - discharge before testing.

fixSteps.title: Verify line voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Must stay above 207 V at start.

title: Communication loss
fullDescription: E6 indicates loss of communication between condenser and air handler. Polarity reversed, broken thermostat wire, or water in connector.
safetyWarning: Low-voltage but a short can blow the transformer fuse.

title: Indoor blower fault
fullDescription: E7 means ECM blower is off-target RPM for 60 seconds. Cooling call is suspended to prevent coil freeze.
safetyWarning: Blower may start abruptly when fault clears.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Allow ice to thaw with blower-only.

faq.a: Yes - low airflow drops coil temp below freezing.

title: Discharge over-temperature
fullDescription: E8 indicates discharge thermistor above setpoint (~270 F). Damages oil and windings if sustained.
safetyWarning: Allow discharge line to cool 30 minutes before touching.

title: Inverter fault
fullDescription: E9 is a generic inverter fault on iQ Drive Maytag HVAC condensers. Drive is replaced as a sealed unit.
safetyWarning: DC bus capacitors hold lethal charge for 5+ minutes.

fixSteps.title: Power off + 5 min
fixSteps.instruction: Verify zero V at DC bus.

title: Reversing valve fault (heat pump)
shortDescription: Reversing valve failed to shift modes.
fullDescription: E10 indicates reversing valve did not shift between cooling and heating. Stuck slide or open coil.
safetyWarning: Valve replacement requires recovery and brazing.

fixSteps.title: Test coil
fixSteps.instruction: Ohm coil. Open = replace coil only.
